title: Indirect reads handed to an uncontracted callee stay refused: 7,946 leaves on 2,177 Unknown functions, 180 sole-blocked
why: The call argument rule admits an actual only at a position a contract in force declares; without a contract the call itself is refused (`call to uncontracted function`), so admitting the actual would only exchange the leaf. Measured at the W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS AFTER census (family_residuals.txt, class uncontracted; the family is W43's call-argument class widened by the card's call stream). The class belongs to the call routes: declared contracts or validated W4 summaries (W44-CORPUS-CALLEE-SUMMARIES). DISCHARGE: contracts or validated summaries for these callees, after which the existing rule applies unchanged, measured; or a recorded decision per callee. Re-measured on the combined tree (merge of main 70ce6b44, census run of 9c8b7809; family_residuals.txt).

title: Contracted Borrowed or tail actuals the typed recogniser refuses: 1,762 leaves on 795 Unknown functions, 97 sole-blocked
why: Measured at the W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS AFTER census (family_residuals.txt, classes untyped:*): member addresses over records the declaration reader did not complete or reached through a chain (`mtx_lock(&(rkbuf->rkbuf_rkb)->rkb_logname_lock)`) 508 / 203 / 28; functions whose declarations are unreadable 336 / 118 / 4; other shapes, mostly `sizeof (*v)` (W44-COLLECTION-ALLOCATION's operand) 249 / 218 / 54; member chains (the recogniser refuses every chain; W44-INDIRECT-CHAIN-ACCESS admits chains in statements without a call) 219 / 127 / 4; untyped bases 160 / 108 / 3; untyped members 141 / 73 / 5; nested calls 94 / 75 / 1; casts 55 / 43 / 3 (leaves / Unknown functions / sole-blocked; the function counts overlap between classes). DISCHARGE: the reader, chain and allocation cards' admissions reaching these actuals through the same recogniser, re-measured; or a recorded decision per class. Re-measured on the combined tree (merge of main 70ce6b44, census run of 9c8b7809; family_residuals.txt).

title: A call result stored through an access (`p->f = g()`, `a[i].f = g()`) stays refused: 948 leaves on 516 Unknown functions, 37 sole-blocked
why: The third shape W43-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS named. The refused access is the destination, not an actual, so the call argument rule does not apply; O00-B08's aggregate store and W43-INDEXED-RESOURCE-COLLECTIONS' element store admit narrow cases. Measured at the W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS AFTER census (family_residuals.txt, class destination). DISCHARGE: a card that admits a call result's store through a typed access with the store's own custody premises (a field link or an element), Lean parity and a measured re-pin; or a recorded decision. The class grew on the combined tree because W44-ASSIGNMENT-DESTINATION-SUFFIX-PLACE (constraint 5i) now refuses every sub-object store at the lexical gate, including `a[i].f = g()` stores that were modeled under a misnamed destination before. Re-measured on the combined tree (merge of main 70ce6b44, census run of 9c8b7809; family_residuals.txt).

title: Indirect actuals at custody-taking positions stay refused by design: 505 leaves on 251 Unknown functions, 4 sole-blocked
why: A read through an indirection handed to an `Owned`, `Consumed`, `Released`, `Out`, `Stored` or `Removed` position would give the callee custody of an object the projection cannot name (`free(p->buf)`, `cfl_sds_destroy(x->key)`), so the rule refuses it (Lean: a_custody_position_is_never_used). Measured at the AFTER census: typed reads 159 / 77 / 2 and untyped ones 346 / 184 / 3. DISCHARGE: a projection that names member- and element-held identities (field links or collections reaching these objects) with Lean parity, measured; or a recorded decision that these stay refused. Re-measured on the combined tree (merge of main 70ce6b44, census run of 9c8b7809; family_residuals.txt).

title: Call actuals in `for` clauses, conditions and returns keep their refusal: 142 leaves on 125 Unknown functions, 39 sole-blocked
why: The call argument rule is consulted only by the statement walker for a simple statement; a condition's isolated call, a `for` clause and a return expression keep the gate's refusal, because the rule's lowering is a block the other positions cannot carry. Measured at the AFTER census (class non-statement). Overlaps W44-BRANCH-CONDITION-CALLS. DISCHARGE: the condition, clause and return routes carrying the same obligations (the typed read before the call), measured. Re-measured on the combined tree (merge of main 70ce6b44, census run of 9c8b7809; family_residuals.txt).

title: Statements whose admitted actuals still classify to a refusal: 52 leaves on 41 Unknown functions, 1 sole-blocked
why: The probe classifies the statement again with the candidates admitted; it keeps the original refusal when the answer is still refused: another actual or the destination still reads memory (36), excess actuals with no declared tail (7), a nested call (6), a discarded owned result (2), an unmodeled formal expression (1). One forecast leaf (check_oauthbearer_extension_value L20297) stays because one of the analyzer's passes reads the statement in an environment without snprintf's declared tail. Measured at the AFTER census. DISCHARGE: the named refusals' own cards, re-measured. Re-measured on the combined tree (merge of main 70ce6b44, census run of 9c8b7809; family_residuals.txt).

title: The call argument rule's use_after_release arm reaches no function of the pinned corpus
why: A base settled on a released identity is refused and accused through W43-INDIRECT-ACCESS-GENERAL's settled-state pass; the arm is unit- and fixture-tested (call_argument_access.rs a_read_after_release_is_accused, a_member_address_after_release_is_accused; chained_tail.rs, o04_trace.rs) and proved (QCore.CallArgumentAccess.a_released_base_refuses_and_is_accused), but neither the card-base AFTER nor the combined-tree AFTER adds a use_after_release leaf. DISCHARGE: a corpus function reaching the arm, with its witness checked; or a recorded decision.

title: W43's shape classifier files 1,580 call-statement leaves outside its call-argument class
why: The frozen forecast used W43-INDIRECT-ACCESS-GENERAL's residuals.py class call-argument (9,522 leaves at the base); its shape classifier files typed declarations (`T * x = f(s.f)`) and other call statements under `chain` (measured by W44-INDIRECT-CHAIN-ACCESS). The card's own call stream records 1,547 more such leaves at the base (1,520 at AFTER); 29 of its removals are there (attribution class rule-unforecast). The widened family is 11,069 / 2,675 / 288 at the base and 10,848 / 2,650 / 286 at AFTER. DISCHARGE: a residual classifier that reads the call stream first, adopted by the census scripts; or a recorded decision. On the combined tree: 1,580 such leaves; the W43 window is 9,776 / 2,442 / 252 and the widened family 11,356 / 2,721 / 295 at AFTER.
